text:
maria (PM): Dropping a short design review for the compact Roles + Invite panel update: https://www.figma.com/file/newfile. Main open items: SSO toggle location, dense rows action affordance, and a one-click path to audit events (thinking a small "Audit" icon + inline timestamp anchors). Can people call out blockers? :eyes:

oliver (Designer): Uploaded a dense variant (6 rows). I kept a subtle, always-visible micro-kebab on the right. Hover-only revealed actions performed poorly in our last tests.

keisha (Frontend): Agree on persistent micro-kebab. Hover reveals caused layout shift on Mobile Safari. Implementation note: keep the action column fixed width to avoid reflow. Touch targets need to stay 44px.

paul (Eng-SRE): Audit access: header icon that opens Audit Finder + timestamp anchors is fine. Route plan: /orgs/:id/audit?anchor=evt_id. Need graceful fallback if audit index not available (show a tooltip or small toast).

sam (Support): From tickets: users get lost with deep navigation. A top-right Audit icon will cut support volume. Also, small confirmation when toggling org-level SSO helps prevent accidental lockouts.

a11y-bot: Quick checklist: 1) micro-kebab must be keyboard focusable + aria-label. 2) roles grid should be semantic (table or labeled list). 3) SSO toggle must expose aria-checked and helper text via aria-describedby. 4) Audit Finder must trap focus and be labelled. 5) ensure visible focus ring on compressed rows and chips.

oliver (Designer): Copy note: replacing "Invite team" with "Invite people" looks better in the panel. For SSO label I propose "Enforce SSO sign-in" with small helper: "blocks non-SSO logins". I'll mock both short label + helper text to avoid wrapping.

keisha (Frontend): We'll wire aria-describedby for the helper text. Also will spike the timestamp anchor behavior Monday and test Safari reflows.

paul (Eng-SRE): I'll add server-side guard for the anchor param so it no-ops if audit not configured. Also agree on a confirmation modal when enabling org-level SSO.

sam (Support): I'll draft KB updates for the SSO wording and the Audit Finder flows once we lock the copy.

a11y-bot: Reminder: run automated axe sweep and include aria attributes in PR description.

maria (PM): Thanks team. Next steps: oliver update mocks with micro-kebab + audit icon + SSO copy variants; keisha spike anchor + fallback; paul add guard + confirm modal; sam KB draft; reconvene Wed morning.
